name: egypt-advisor-tours-client
description: React frontend for Egypt Advisor Tours. NOTE: Most scripts are in the root package.json. Run 'npm run' from the root directory to see all available commands.

scripts.prestart:
node -e "try { require('react-scripts') } catch(e) { console.error('
❌ ERROR: Dependencies not installed!

Please run from the ROOT directory:
  npm run install:all

Or install client dependencies only:
  npm run install:client
'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.help: echo "" && echo "⚠️  You are in the CLIENT directory!" && echo "" && echo "Most commands should be run from the ROOT directory." && echo "" && echo "To go back to root:" && echo "  cd .." && echo "" && echo "Then run:" && echo "  npm run install:all     (install all dependencies)" && echo "  npm run start:client    (start this client)" && echo "  npm run start:server    (start the server)" && echo "" && echo "For more info, see GETTING-STARTED.md in the root directory." && echo ""
